FN-MS4EQWH-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 182
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative Rex Reynolds
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/21/2025
House Bill 182 as introduced would extend the current quarterly assessment on emergency
medical transport (EMT) providers that will expire on July 1, 2025 to July 1, 2028. In fiscal year
2024, $8.6 million in EMT providers' assessments were deposited into the Alabama Health Care
Trust Fund for the Alabama Medicaid Agency.
